group.label: Product family: made to order (FE-85)
group.comment: The text behind the info icon next to "Made To Order:" is the CMS block with the identifier pdp_make_to_order_info_tooltip (Content > Blocks). Disable the block or empty its content to hide the icon.

field.label: Made to order lead time (weeks)
field.comment: Shown next to "Made To Order:" above the fabric swatches. Empty or 0: no lead time is shown.

field.label: Lead time wording
field.comment: %1 becomes the weeks, e.g. "With you in %1" shows "With you in 14 weeks". Empty: the built-in wording.
